already_promoted_packets.method: id-level only: the existence of the leaf directory <packet_root>/<packet_id> is tested. No packet byte, no .feat file and no audio sample is read.

cpu_pipeline.decoder: soundfile header probe for duration and rate; bytes hashed with SHA-256. ffmpeg is absent by design and no media byte is rewritten -- the librosa fallback stays the pinned decode path for every later consumer.

d1_closure.note: The immutable D1 identity artifact closes over the SLURP devel split only, so every row of a test-split roster sits outside it and the additive saea-d1-media-supplement-v1 successor is required. The supplement is written by scripts/build_slurp_stage3_construction_r01_d1_supplement.py, which re-hashes every media file, and this builder carries its pinned triple forward on a rebuild after re-verifying the supplement's bytes.

legacy_feature_cache.key_convention: core.model.speech_features.legacy_audio_feature_cache_key -- FNV-1a over the encoded media bytes, so warmth is a property of the file, not of a prompt

runtime_view.per_file_sha256: one audio_sha256 per row inside the runtime view; the inventory does not duplicate 13078 digests
